# AXE2 cord flex: specification for quotation (generated by rf2/rf2_cordflex.py; MODELED design, not a released drawing)

## 1. Function
Carries the coil transmit pair, head power, three RS-485-class differential pairs and three guarded analog reference pairs from the search head to the hinge of the control chassis, through the 2-stage carbon telescope. Replaces a coiled cable.

## 2. Construction
- Single conductive layer, Kapton polyimide base, **1 mil Kapton / acrylic coverlay** both sides; about 0.15 mm per layer.
- **Selective copper:** 2 oz (0.0028 in) on TX_A, TX_B, VIN_H, GND_H; 0.5 oz on the signal and reference areas (contoured / selective plating). Rolled-annealed copper preferred (dynamic loop).
- Width **15.7 mm** (fits the 18.6 mm bore with 2 mm clearance). Lanes, edge to edge:

| Lane | Width mm |
|---|---|
| edge | 0.75 |
| TX_A | 2.35 |
| TX gap (rule 6) | 1.00 |
| TX_B | 2.35 |
| HV to LV gap (rule 6) | 1.00 |
| VIN_H | 0.30 |
| gap | 0.30 |
| GND_H | 0.30 |
| gap | 0.30 |
| TXCMD pair (2 x 0.15 / 0.15) | 0.45 |
| TXSTAT pair (2 x 0.15 / 0.15) | 0.45 |
| DATA pair (2 x 0.15 / 0.15) | 0.45 |
| gap | 0.30 |
| gap | 0.30 |
| guard gap | 0.30 |
| REFX pair with ground guards (0.15 / 0.15 + 2 x 0.3) | 1.35 |
| REFY pair with ground guards (0.15 / 0.15 + 2 x 0.3) | 1.35 |
| REFZ pair with ground guards (0.15 / 0.15 + 2 x 0.3) | 1.35 |
| edge | 0.75 |

## 3. Pieces and lengths
- **Piece 1 (dynamic):** head gland -> REF3T board, **961 mm**, with a rolling loop storing half of the 550 mm telescope travel; loop bend radius 6.0 mm (40 x stack; IPC single layer >= 6 x).
- **Piece 2 (static):** REF3T -> hinge cord board, **394 mm**.
- Both inside the 40 in (1016 mm) preferred length of Tech Etch long flex; one-piece (1315 mm) only on a 5 ft (Minco) / 60 in (Tech Etch advanced) process.

## 4. Electrical requirements
- **High voltage (project rule 6):** TX_A / TX_B carry the coil flyback, 460 V peak (clamp). Spacing >= 1.0 mm TX-TX and TX-to-everything. **Net-to-net hipot >= 1000 VRMS, 60 Hz, 30 s, <= 1 mA** (Minco typical; Kapton aged rating 2000-3000 V/mil, Sierra HV notebook). No sharp copper corners on TX (round all bends and pad ends).
- **Current:** TX 3.67 A rms (continuous boost), traces 2.35 mm at 2 oz for a 10 K rise (IPC-2221 internal); loop resistance about 0.28 ohm out and back over 1.355 m. VIN_H / GND_H 0.45 A, 0.30 mm.
- **Capacitance:** TX strip pair about 28.1 pF/m (coplanar strips, eps_eff 1.6 ASSUMED): the vendor to report the measured value (it sets the first gate, rf2_timing_cord).
- **Reference pairs:** 0.15 / 0.15 mm pairs with 0.3 mm ground guards each side; guards tied at REF3T only.

## 5. Terminations
- Solder lands only (no connector on the TX strips): head gland board, REF3T board (joint of pieces 1 and 2), hinge cord board.
- Strain relief: a pin through a loop of the flex at the gland boss (SDC 2300 coil-cable pin pattern); stiffeners (polyimide) under the land areas.

## 6. Environment and test
- -20 to +60 C use (acrylic adhesive rated -65 to 105 C); field moisture (potted gland ends).
- Tests: continuity, insulation resistance, the hipot above, dynamic flex life on the rolling loop (cycles to be agreed; telescoping several times per session), measured TX capacitance.

## 7. Open with the vendor
- Exact stack (adhesive vs adhesiveless), selective-copper process, RA copper in the loop, flex-life data at the 6 mm loop radius, price for 2 pieces vs 1.
